line: The road keeps no promises. Hold your line, save your steel, and watch the smoke. Out here, the last engine running tells the story.

directions.name: Dust and drums
directions.philosophy: The road is bigger than the driver. Sparse drums make room for exposed machinery; distant guitar carries the horizon. Violence arrives as a dry interruption.
directions.listenFor: Does the empty space feel dangerous, or does the race lose momentum? Can the dry impacts stay legible against the drums?
directions.music: Sparse huge skin war drums with dry attacks, low toms and rim knocks, distant tape-echo baritone guitar fragments, dust-dry bass, broad empty space between hits. An exposed outdoor wasteland, raw analog grain, tense forward motion without a busy rock arrangement.
directions.material: Dust-dry outdoor mechanical foley, exposed natural metal and leather, close transient with a small distant air tail, raw tape grain. Sparse, no polished studio sheen.
colours: loose exhaust rasp and a thin rattling chassis
dry bolt chatter and small brass ticks
earthy low thump with gravel and a short dusty debris hiss
buckled thin steel and a hard chassis knock
a scavenged ammunition tin latch and a brief loose metal jingle
a heavy weathered lever locking into a leather-damped notch

directions.name: Diesel brutalism
directions.philosophy: The engine is the centre of the score. Repeating machine rhythm and low pressure turn the race into a working foundry; impacts are dense, clipped punctuation.
directions.listenFor: Does the weight remain readable on small speakers? Does relentless machinery become fatiguing or bury the driver feedback?
directions.music: Heavy industrial metal-on-metal percussion, piston rhythms, low distorted bass drones, abrasive resonant steel, nearly no melody. Dense but separated transients, engine-forward mechanical insistence, threatening close physical pressure, deliberately unpolished analog saturation.
directions.material: Close foundry machinery, heavy steel, blunt low-mid weight, gritty analog saturation without digital clipping, very short concrete reflection. Severe and utilitarian.
colours: heavy uneven diesel piston knocks and vibrating steel casing
a hard pneumatic rivet mechanism and rattling steel bolt
a compressed concussive steel drum thud with torn plate debris
a dense chassis crush and wrenching heavy steel
a power relay slamming into an iron latch with a pressure release
a massive industrial toggle closing with a hard spring snap

directions.name: Grindhouse funk
directions.philosophy: Danger has swagger. A dirty bass groove and raw breaks give the race comic momentum; mechanical gestures bounce against the rhythm and the voice sells the spectacle.
directions.listenFor: Does the groove fit Hot Ink without making combat harmless? Are brass and wah leaving space for weapons and speech?
directions.music: Gritty syncopated electric bass riff, raw live drum break, short blunt brass stabs and scratchy wah guitar, dry room, worn tape, crooked comic swagger with real danger. Tight restrained arrangement, punchy and dirty, not glossy disco, no smooth lounge finish.
directions.material: Dirty close garage foley, springy mechanical snap, loose resonant metal, raw short room sound, lively syncopated gesture but no pitched musical phrase. Dangerous comic punch.
colours: a throaty coupe idle with a loose spring rattle
a snappy stuttering gun mechanism and loose brass clacks
a punchy low blast followed by a loose spring-metal debris rattle
a blunt car panel crunch followed by a quick loose bumper twang
a sprung parts-tray latch snapping and two loose hardware clacks
a chunky mechanical pushbutton with a short spring bounce

directions.name: Soot noir
directions.philosophy: Threat comes from what is withheld. Low strings and sub pulses keep tension under the wheels; intimate, damped details and quiet menace make each collision matter.
directions.listenFor: Does restraint feel tense or merely slow? Can the intimate detail survive the engine, and does the sub pulse translate beyond headphones?
directions.music: Dark low bowed strings, restrained dry sub-bass pulses, sparse brushed metal ticks, uneasy short low-string motif, smoky tense cinema atmosphere. Close intimate detail, rough bow texture, long gaps, no lush swelling orchestra, no sentimental melody.
directions.material: Smoky intimate close-miked mechanical foley, damped heavy metal and low gritty resonance, extremely restrained high end, tiny dry enclosed reflection. Threatening through restraint.
colours: a low muffled motor throb with subtle strained bearing grit
a tight damped bolt crack and dark hollow shell tick
a low compact concussive thud and brief dark fractured-metal tail
a deep restrained chassis groan with one sharp panel crease
a small cold steel catch closing with one low hollow resonance
a dry worn ratchet tooth seating into a felt-damped latch
